$description: The roles that only pages use: the type scale, spacing, radii, border widths, layers and the widths of drawers. One tier: each token holds its value, the same in every theme, and the pages use it as a CSS custom property of the same name. Type has four body sizes, 11, 12, 13 and 14px, and three display sizes, 18, 24 and 32px. Spacing is on a 4px scale: space-2 is step 2, 8px. Its one half step is space-0-5, 2px, for the padding of badges and chips; CSS allows no dot in a name, so a half step ends in -5. Radius has three steps, a pill and a round. src/lib/scale.test.ts holds the scales.

font-body.$description: The font of the page: the system font, the first one the system has.

font-size-3xs.$description: 11px. Uppercase labels, captions and table heads.

font-size-xs.$description: 12px. Small and meta text: notes, hints, badges, chips, legends and the labels of fields and segments.

font-size-md.$description: 13px. The body text: the page, tables, inputs, buttons and the links of the navigation.

font-size-xl.$description: 14px. Emphasis and values: the values of a meta row, the title of a drawer and a large badge.

font-size-2xl.$description: 18px. A title: the title of a page, the name of the app, a headline and the close sign of a drawer.

font-size-3xl.$description: 24px. A score and a key number. It is large text, so a colour with 3:1 may draw it: the band of a score.

font-size-4xl.$description: 32px. The one hero number of a page, such as the posture score of the Resilience page.

font-weight-normal.$description: 400, regular. Text that keeps the regular weight inside bold text.

font-weight-medium.$description: 500, medium. A value that stands out a little, such as the name of the weakest score.

font-weight-strong.$description: 600, semi-bold. Headings, table heads, badges and numbers that stand out.

font-weight-bold.$description: 700, bold. The name of the app.

line-height-body.$description: 1.5 times the font size. The body text and text areas.

line-height-tight.$description: 1 times the font size. A line as tall as its text: a sign, such as the close sign of a drawer.

letter-spacing-sm.$description: 0.5px. Uppercase table heads and labels, badges and the name of the app.

letter-spacing-md.$description: 0.6px. Small uppercase labels, such as the labels of a meta row and the titles of panels.

space-0-5.$description: 2px. The half step of the spacing scale: only the padding of badges and chips.

space-15.$description: 60px. Step 15 of the spacing scale: the room under the content of a page.

radius-md.$description: 4px. Small boxes and small buttons, such as skeletons, notices and the buttons of a toggle.

radius-pill.$description: 999px. A pill: badges and chips. A box less than 1998px high has round ends.

radius-round.$description: 50%. A circle: a dot or a ring. The format has no percent, so the value is a number, and the extension of Tumult gives it the unit %.

border-width-sm.$description: 1px. The lines of panels, tables, inputs and buttons.

border-width-md.$description: 2px. An edge that stands out: the active link, a focus ring, a marked node.

border-width-lg.$description: 4px. A thick edge that marks a state.

z-raised.$description: 1. Above the rest of its box: the grid lines of the span waterfall.

z-sticky.$description: 2. A sticky head above the raised layer: the time ruler of the span waterfall.

drawer-narrow.$description: 480px. The width of a narrow drawer, such as the span drawer.

drawer-wide.$description: 620px. The width of a wide drawer, such as the evidence of a DORA row.
